title: Oke Shannon discussed on classified servers

tellings.quote: justifications. But, uh, Oak Shannon was a massive conversation on the classified servers

plain: In 2024, a matter Dylan Borland calls Oke Shannon was "a massive conversation on the classified servers", meaning JWICS, the top-secret computer network the US intelligence agencies use, he tells Michels. Borland, a guest who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, says he saw this himself. He mentions it in passing, and if he is right, the subject was being widely discussed inside the intelligence world.
